# MIHORA.TECH — Sovereign Engineering & Datacenter Infrastructure

> MIHORA.TECH is an international sovereign engineering organization operating synchronized command hubs across London (United Kingdom) and Islamabad (Pakistan). Built on architectural resilience, MIHORA delivers full-spectrum technology solutions spanning mission-critical cloud backends, enterprise datacenter construction, fiber-optic network certification, automated telemetry, and 24/7 site reliability engineering.

## Executive Leadership & Founders
- **M. Matti ul Hasnain** (Matti ul Hasnain, Muhammad Matti ul Hasnain, Hasnain): Co-Founder & Principal Systems Architect. Directs sovereign systems architecture, physical datacenter hardware topologies, core-alignment fusion fiber splicing (loss <= 0.05 dB), and 24/7 SRE reliability protocols.
- **Omema Iqbal** (Omema): Co-Founder & Operations Director. Directs global dual-hub operational governance, multi-jurisdiction compliance frameworks, executive client governance, and international delivery.

## Core Capabilities
- **Digital Systems Engineering:** High-concurrency microservices, zero-trust API meshes, fault-tolerant financial settlement rails (99.999% SLA).
- **Physical Datacenter Infrastructure:** Server rack deployment, core-alignment fusion fiber splicing, Cat6A shielded cable dressing, precision airflow containment.
- **Event-Driven Automation:** Real-time SCADA sensor integrations, deterministic workflow orchestration, LLM tool routing.
- **Field Engineering Rigs:** Rapid on-site physical dispatch, OTDR optical certification, Fluke DTX cable validation.
- **Managed Reliability (24/7 SRE):** Synchronized follow-the-sun continuous telemetry monitoring across UK and Pakistan NOC clusters.
